blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several areas reached danger-level heat indices on Wednesday amid the effects of El Niño, the state weather bureau said. Indices ranging between 42°C and 51°C are categorized by the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) as “danger” level due to increased risks of heat cramps and heat exhaustion, which could then lead to heat stroke.
